digest_method: sha256 over the preregistration's parsed contract fields excluding the `seal` block, serialised as JSON with sorted keys and no whitespace
reproduce: python -c "import yaml,json,hashlib;d=yaml.safe_load(open('01-preregistration.yaml',encoding='utf-8'));b={k:v for k,v in d.items() if k!='seal'};print(hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(b,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest())"
note: Sealed before any statistic was computed. QROS-PREREG-SEAL-BEFORE-EXPOSURE. Any later change to the contract fields changes this digest and is therefore detectable.
